description_en: Queries created SSL client certificates by calling the DescribeSslVpnClientCerts operation

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the SSL client certificate that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL client certificate belongs.

The SSL client certificate belongs to the same resource group as its associated SSL server. You can call the [DescribeSslVpnServers](~~2794078~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the SSL server.
